changelog:
Testing Build (vc23-1010) vs Testing Build (vc24-1010)

Changes

- Stacks (phase 1): new Stacks section to manage groups of identical containers behind a load balancer. Templates: nginx, apache, php, node, python (packages installed on first build) plus Ankfile mode. Per stack: auto-scaling (requests / cpu / mem / combined triggers, or disabled), self-healing, rolling update, manual scale up/down, per-container logs, metrics and inspect. The load balancer picks a free port in 30000-39999 (falls back to the next free port and shows a warning when the requested one is taken); stack replicas use service ports 40000-49999 (host and container port are the same) and ankd ports 50000-59999.

- No more iptables for container ports: all isolated containers (stack or regular) are now reached through a userspace TCP forwarder managed by the server. SSH and service ports survive reboots, mode changes and updates because the orchestrator re-applies every 10 seconds whatever the container config asks for; stale forwards are released automatically.

- Cleaner fresh installs: the installer and the module setup now also remove the hidden update-backup folder, so a brand-new install shows a truly empty Update History - no phantom entry and no phantom Rollback button pointing at leftovers from a previous install.

- Safer rollbacks: before touching anything the updater validates the backup (tarball integrity and content), snapshots the version you are on, syntax-checks the restored server and waits for it to come back after the restart. If any of those steps fail, the version you were on is restored automatically - a failed rollback can no longer leave the device without a panel.
